_comment: Counterpart to golden_queries.json: the short, identifier-shaped terms
people actually type into a code search box today, as opposed to the full
natural-language questions the semantic mode is built for.
Without this set the comparison is rigged. Scoring only NL questions shows
the vector engine beating BM25 at a game BM25 was never playing, and says
nothing about the risk that matters operationally: whether turning hybrid
on degrades the queries that already work.
